claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Foundational attributes govern all expressed abilities; skills always derived from Tier 1.
claims.rationale: A disposition or capacity may affect performance but does not constitute task knowledge or practiced competence. Historical weights are illustrative rather than calibrated.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Store independently learned skills and explicit access/knowledge; capacities modulate task-specific performance.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: BaseValue = Genetic_Roll*h + Environmental_Roll*(1-h), both rolls 0–100; fixed heritability per attribute.
claims.rationale: Heritability partitions variance in a population and environment, not an individual causal percentage. With equal independent roll variances the formula gives realized genetic variance fraction h²/[h²+(1-h)²], not h.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: No genetic roll pipeline in MVP. Future population generators need specified covariance, context, and independent validation.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Gf 60% heritability (Q); 40–80% and most heritable intelligence component (B); Gs 45%.
claims.rationale: Reported quantities conflate g and Gf and turn context-specific estimates into universal constants. Cited 2023 synthesis gives different patterns.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Keep capacities operationally defined; no hereditary truth labels or inherited learning ceilings.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Metabolic Profile heritability 45%.
claims.rationale: Cited estimate concerns captive zebra finches.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: No imported human metabolic genotype coefficient.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: High BMR implies peak performance; low BMR implies efficiency/scarcity resilience, represented on −100…100 axis.
claims.rationale: Resting expenditure, maximal output, body size, health and efficiency are distinct. Microbial rate/yield trade-offs cannot validate a fixed human bipolar profile.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Use declared energy/fatigue abstractions now; physiology adapter later.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Biomechanical aptitude heritability 45%; force versus finesse on −100…100 axis.
claims.rationale: Fiber-type proportion is not global motor competence, precision, coordination, or a necessary force–finesse opposition.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Do not force a character strong in one dimension to be weak in the other.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Big Five fixed heritabilities O 61%, C 44%, E 53%, A 41%, N 41%; −100…100 scales.
claims.rationale: The numbers are traceable to one twin study; their existence does not validate universal percentages. Bipolar normalized scale is a convention.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Optional tendencies as priors; behavior also depends on situation, goals and learning.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Attachment Schema 0% hereditary; categorical secure/anxious/avoidant; anxious–avoidant pair naturally produces pursuer–distancer pattern.
claims.rationale: Adolescent attachment twin research suggests genetic influence; infancy results and adult relationship patterns cannot be equated. Categories do not dictate a dyad.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Relational expectations belong to relationship/context-sensitive beliefs, not hardwired deterministic pairing rules.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Locus of control 0% hereditary; internal failure means train, external means wait/give up; −100…100 scale.
claims.rationale: Adult twin data contradict zero as universal claim. Internal/external attribution is distinct from controllable/uncontrollable and stable/unstable causes.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Use actor-specific causal belief updates; preserve external constraints and mistaken self-blame as possible.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Lifetime change cap BaseValue ± BaseValue*Malleability_Index; Gf ±15%, Gs ±25%, metabolism ±20%, biomechanics ±15%, O ±20%, C ±30%, E ±20%, A ±30%, N ±30%.
claims.rationale: No source establishes these lifetime caps. Negative bases reverse interval order and zero bases prohibit all change; arbitrary scale origin changes allowed development.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Use explicit bounded state domains with model-specific learning dynamics; no birth-relative moral/trait cages.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Gf and Gs +0.5/year ages 1–25, then Gf −0.25/year and Gs −0.2/year; Gf peak 25–30.
claims.rationale: Task-specific trajectories and heterogeneous peaks do not justify one linear annual schedule.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: MVP spans hours/days; lifespan adapter needs longitudinal task-specific calibration.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Physical peak 25–35; ~10% decline/decade with acceleration after 60; table uses −1%/year after 35 offset by training.
claims.rationale: Aerobic capacity, strength, precision and performance are different endpoints; a global decline is not established. Text and table have different acceleration assumptions.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Separate skill retention from bodily capacity; aging outside first scenarios.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Personality annual O −0.1 and E −0.1 after 20; C +0.2 ages 20–50; A +0.2 and N −0.2 ages 20–60.
claims.rationale: Cross-sectional population differences do not yield each person’s causal annual drift, and the source includes nonlinear patterns.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: No hidden annual stat drift in MVP.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: XP=BaseXP*Difficulty*(1+(Gf−50)/100); Gf is global learning multiplier, +50% at Gf100; Gf controls knowledge library size.
claims.rationale: No cited experiment identifies this universal function across motor, social and knowledge tasks.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Task-specific learning rates, practice quality, opportunity and known procedures; no omnipotent intelligence stat.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Relevant practice accumulates a Dosage Meter and crosses level thresholds.
claims.rationale: Practice dose is useful bookkeeping; discrete XP thresholds and universal conversion are engineering conventions.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Track relevant practice and competence change, expose coefficients as provisional.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Every skill XP gain transfers 1–5% to underlying Gf/Gs XP pools.
claims.rationale: The attached source found no untrained-task transfer. Positive findings in specific paradigms do not justify transfer from every skill.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Zero transfer by default; explicit directed task-to-task transfer adapter only.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Skill decays as last_value*exp(−k*time_since_use); k inversely proportional to skill level.
claims.rationale: Forgetting is plausible, but neither this shape nor inverse-proficiency k is universal. Skill, retention and retrieval performance differ.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Separate practice/retention/expression; allow task-specific decay and elapsed-time-invariant integration.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: All expressed abilities range 1–1000; cognitive attributes 1–100; several traits −100…100.
claims.rationale: Arbitrary mixed scales make weighted combinations dimensionally ambiguous.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Use units/ranges per operational variable; normalized internal scale declared as simulation convention.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Endurance=.7 metabolic efficiency+.2 conscientiousness+.1 internal locus.
claims.rationale: Handwritten weights conflate bodily capacity, willingness and attribution.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Compute ability, intent and effort separately.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Melee=.6 force+.3 Gs−.1 neuroticism; ranged=.6 finesse+.3 Gs−.1 neuroticism; dexterity=.7 finesse+.2 Gf+.1 conscientiousness.
claims.rationale: No coefficient evidence; anxiety can have context-specific effects and motor skills require learning.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Task-specific execution adapters with uncertainty and learned proficiency.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Persuasion=.4 extraversion+.3 agreeableness+.3 secure attachment; leadership=.4 extraversion+.3 internal locus+.3 conscientiousness.
claims.rationale: Treats dispositions as acquired expertise and encodes an untested ideal leader/personality.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Social outcomes depend on listener beliefs, relationship, legitimacy, content and context.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Deception=.4 Gf+.4 avoidant attachment−.2 agreeableness; insight=.5 secure attachment+.3 openness+.2 Gf.
claims.rationale: Unsupported linkage pathologizes attachment and grants mind-reading from traits.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: No attachment-to-dishonesty rule; inference remains uncertain and audience-specific.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Humanities=.6 Gf+.4 openness; sciences=.7 Gf+.3 openness; medicine/engineering=.6 Gf+.2 finesse+.2 conscientiousness; programming=.8 Gf+.2 conscientiousness; data=.7 Gf+.3 openness; cybersecurity=.6 Gf+.2 Gs−.2 neuroticism.
claims.rationale: No task data justify coefficients; high capacities cannot provide unlearned factual or procedural knowledge.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Separate domain knowledge from skill and ability. No programming skill simply from birth stats.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Athletics formula truncated after (Metabolic_Pace*.5)+(.
claims.rationale: Source table is syntactically incomplete.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Do not treat production-ready title as implementation evidence.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Gs globally changes crafting, aiming, searching, reading and dialogue-selection time.
claims.rationale: These tasks contain different motor, perceptual, linguistic, decision and interface components.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Use per-action duration; display time and simulation time separated.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Autonomy, competence, relatedness meters continuously cause replenishment actions; cites B3.
claims.rationale: SDT is a useful motivational lens but the citation is microbial metabolism and no reservoir dynamics are established.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Represent perceived opportunities/constraints or motives, with explicit engineering dynamics and no obligatory fixed ordering.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Nafs=impulsive System1 ego; ruh=altruistic ideal; aql=Gf/Gc calculator; qalb=weighted arbiter.
claims.rationale: No Islamic sources supplied. Textual terms are not interchangeable with psychological subsystems; Qur’an connects hearts and reasoning and limits knowledge of ruh.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Use ordinary names for motivations, deliberation, intention and commitments; keep theological concepts as attributed interpretive annotations.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Qalb health 0–100; altruism/sacrifice/honesty heal; selfishness/cruelty/deception damage; low score boosts ego weights.
claims.rationale: Scalar spiritual ranking and action-only judgments conceal intention/context and permit circular self-validating morality.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: No spiritual health scalar or divine approval score. Track declared commitments, observed action, intention and consequences separately.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Three compulsory self-development stages: commanding default, reproaching, tranquil; final stage unlocks abilities/status.
claims.rationale: Scriptural language is not an authenticated finite-state game progression or externally measurable spiritual rank.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Character development can be modeled with revisable habits, commitments and repair actions without assigning religious attainment.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Positive/negative choices alter future tendencies and generate traceable emergent narratives.
claims.rationale: Feedback and path dependence are useful engineering candidates, provided the transition is not presented as measured universal moral physiology.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Keep causal logs and reversible counterfactual replay; distinguish world effects, beliefs, habits and choices.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Complex emergent behavior is guaranteed by interconnected tiers; blueprint is production ready.
claims.rationale: No code, fitted parameters, outcome benchmark, stability proof, validation, or reproducible run is present.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Demonstrate modular reuse and compare against simpler baselines; emergence is a result to measure, not a certification.

claims.mechanism_or_numerical_claim: Intellect example predicts a 70% chance of being caught stealing.
claims.rationale: An illustrative probability with no observation model or calibration; it must be the character’s belief rather than privileged world truth.
claims.mvp_architecture_effect: Separate subjective outcome estimates from world outcome generators; record confidence, provenance and revision.
